title: Wooden weapons

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Wooden weapons is a series of weapons that deals only 1 damage. They are mainly suited for training and practice matches between players.
They can all be repaired at a level 1 Workbench, but they can not be upgraded except for the Wooden sword. All have 12 block armor.

table_data.Name: Wooden sword
table_data.Source: Crafted at Workbench for 5 Wood, 3 Finewood and 2 Corewood.

table_data.Name: Wooden axe
table_data.Source: Found in chest buried in Viking Graveyard.

table_data.Source: Found in chest buried in Viking Graveyard.

table_data.Name: Wooden spear
table_data.Source: Found in chest in Abandoned Outpost and in Abandoned Hut.

table_data.Name: Wooden sledge
table_data.Source: Found in chest in Swamp Runestone Tower and in Swamp Graves.

table_data.Name: Wooden greatsword
table_data.Source: Found in Infested Mine Treasure chest.
